metadata.weighting: Equal per composition, size, tech, direction and power case. Role failures remain visible.
metadata.sampling: Screen: 30 seeds at size20, stronger attacker. Validation: held-out seeds; sizes20/50/100/200, both directions; 100/40/20/10 trials.
metadata.score: Mean per-battle squared distance outside target bands. Near: physical survivors separately for both sides. Unequal: weaker escaped share, inactive weakness and stronger control.
metadata.selection: Diagnostic ranking is not a global optimum. Final table combines A-low at 1/2, A-middle at 1.5, A-high at 3 to approach average ratio targets; per-role misses are reported.
